Dialog external-call code in this directory is owned by DialogQCA.

Use this directory for DialogQCA-specific dialog external-call logic that does not
belong in shared provider code.

If DialogQCA external-call code is reusable by more than one product and it is R-specific,
move it under shared/runtime/providers/r/external/.

If it is reusable by all products and all providers, move it under
shared/external/.
